contract.provenance: Every option is harvested from a committed state-pack module. This file invents no county and no court.
contract.manualEntry: A participant may always type a value the list does not carry. That value is stored separately and is never treated as verified.
contract.compatibility: A jurisdiction absent from `jurisdictions` renders exactly as it did before: the existing free-text question, unchanged.
contract.parity: This is published as an additive field on the question. No question id, type, stage, options array, required flag or contextOnly flag changes, so the screening-parity gate is unaffected and no approved delta is consumed.
